body:
Nina (PM): Quick follow-up from the design critique today. We have three small but important asks for the autoscale UI: clarify "burst" wording, make the SLO slider announcements more helpful, and reduce visual noise in the pool picker. Short thread to capture decisions.

Ezra (Design): For burst, propose: label in detail pane 'Burst capacity (temporary)' and keep the compact badge as '+burst'. Tooltip on badge: 'Temporary extra capacity when available'. That keeps lists compact but clear on detail.

Carmen (Eng): Backend: will add pool fields `burst_available` (bool) and `burst_scope` (string) for tooltip text. Also we can return `predicted_cost_delta_cents` on preview endpoints to power inline estimates.

Vik (Frontend): I'll update UI: compact row shows '+burst' badge + `aria-label` that expands for screen readers. For SLO slider, I'll add an `aria-live` region that reads: 'Target latency X ms — estimated Y qps, estimated cost $Z/day'. Want to confirm phrasing.

Samir (Accessibility): That phrasing is good but tweak to be explicit: 'Target latency 120 milliseconds. Estimated throughput 40 Q.P.S. Estimated cost twelve dollars per day.' Use `aria-valuetext` on the slider and ensure live region uses plain text so TTS reads numbers naturally.

Ezra (Design): Also remove inline min/max numbers from the most compact rows; keep them in expanded capacity row to reduce scanning noise. Add a tiny sparkline under the name to show trend — subtle only.

Carmen (Eng): Sparkline: we can add `slo_samples` as 5 floats in the search response. Keep it optional via `?include_sparkline=true`.

Vik (Frontend): Keyboard note: when capacity row expands, focus must stay on the row. I'll adopt `role=listbox` + `aria-activedescendant` and ensure ArrowUp/Down remain consistent. Also add 'u' shortcut to undo min/max changes while the toast is visible.

Samir (Accessibility): Toasts should be `role=status` and `aria-live=polite`. Provide an accessible Undo button and ensure the confirmation dialog traps focus if used.

Nina (PM): Good. Action items: Ezra — update mocks with 'Burst capacity (temporary)' and compact tweaks; Carmen — add `burst_available,burst_scope,predicted_cost_delta_cents,slo_samples` fields; Vik — implement aria live updates, keyboard fixes, and undo toast; Samir — quick a11y pass on the live text and toast behavior. ETA: EOD Fri.
